installCommand: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | UV_INSTALL_DIR=$PWD/.uvbin UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh && export UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=automatic && .uvbin/uv python install 3.11 && .uvbin/uv sync
buildCommand: .uvbin/uv run reflex export --frontend-only && mkdir -p frontend && unzip -o frontend.zip -d frontend
